messages:
Alex: FYI Nimbustherm asking for a 6-month Dedicated commit (≈4k GPU-hrs/mo, 80% A100 / 20% H100) and pushing for 30% off + 3x burst for irregular spikes. Need Deal Desk + Finance sign-off.
Priya: Do they plan to convert to annual afterwards or is this lifecycle limited to 6 months?
Alex: They want a trial 6mo with option to extend to 12mo if model perf is good. No firm conversion commitment today.
Marta: 30% is above POC/short-term bounds. Standard approvals: up to 15% for 12mo, 10% for <12mo. Exceptions require revenue protection (prepay/credits) or CRO sign-off.
Tom: Finance: For a 6mo with no firm conversion, 30% is not approvable. We can entertain 20% if customer prepays first 2 months or provides an early-termination fee.
Janice: Legal: any exception needs explicit billing language (how burst is metered & invoiced), credit/rollback terms, and a capacity fallback clause if H100s unavailable. Also want a clause limiting outsized burst duration.
Alex: Customer insists burst at 3x for peak weeks, says they can prepay 2 months upfront but want a lower burst multiplier during normal bursts.
Marta: Proposed compromise: 20% off for 6 months, require 2-month prepayment applied as credit, burst multiplier capped at 2x (not 3x) and burst hours capped at 25% of monthly commit. Include refundable conversion credit equal to prepay if they sign a 12mo within 30 days after term.
Priya: Ops config to provision if approved: ```pool: "nimbus-dedicated-1" gpus: [{type:"A100",pct:80},{type:"H100",pct:20}] commit_hours:4000/month burst_policy:{multiplier:2.0, max_pct:25} prepaid_credit:2_months```
Tom: Finance sign-off (conditional): 20% with 2-month prepay and ETT clause. Anything deeper discount -> CFO+CRO.
Marta: Deal Desk records exception and will attach the approval memo. Need Janice to review SOW language for billing + fallback.
Janice: Will draft SOW clauses (billing, burst caps, capacity fallback to A100 at pro-rated rates).
infra-bot: Provision ticket created: TKT-5598, tentative pool=nimbus-dedicated-1, pending legal + billing finalization.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll send the draft offer to Nimbustherm and cc legal. Will update when they respond. :thumbsup:
